description: Pause or resume a tracked account (muted), move it to a keyword group (groupId), or set its monthly follower cap (cap, null removes it).

anyOf.description: A monthly cap on billed new followers.

followers.description: New followers billed in a UTC calendar month at most; past it the account stops being read until the 1st.

cap.description: Set the monthly follower cap; null removes it.

groupId.description: Move it to this keyword group (grp_...).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

muted.description: Pause (true) or resume (false) reading and charging it.

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.

name: update_account
title: Update account
